spec_match.rationale: Creates AudioContexts with the real renderSizeHint option (integers and 'hardware'), reads renderQuantumSize back, and the worklet works on the actual granted block size.

interactive.rationale: Start/stop, quantum picker, live DSP-load slider messaged into the running worklet, a main-thread jank button, live meters, and a recorded-runs comparison table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card and page both describe the measured render-deficit trade-off; the card was updated when the metric changed from arrival gaps to rate deficit.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles autoplay-suspended start, worklet-not-reporting stop, unsupported browsers (honest fixed-128 banner with exact flags), and pagehide context cleanup; the measurement's own failure modes are documented in the honesty note.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5078190552907776, the renderSizeHint spec anchor, and the v145 quantum-sweep it deliberately goes beyond (formula vs measurement).

conformance.rationale: The feature suite pins the constructor/attribute contracts this lab relies on; the lab itself adds the behavioural (non-assertable) load story.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Real-time CDP run on headless Chromium 141+flag: zero-load deficit stayed bounded (~24 ms), load 3000 grew the deficit to 364 ms with a stall episode, jank button did not stall the render thread, and two runs recorded into the table; console/network clean bar the environmental fonts failure. Not chrome-devtools-mcp (unavailable in this sandbox).

telemetry_health.rationale: usl-support (fallback asserted false), usl-start (suspended/error branches asserted false), usl-run-recorded with deficit/stall payload.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only, amber honesty accent used on a stone background with charcoal text (AA), per-tile bordered meters replaced the gap-trick grid that produced a black filler cell.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled native controls (44px min targets), range slider with aria-describedby, dl-based meters with text values, aria-live polite status, captioned runs table.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x1400 desktop: controls wrap, meters reflow via auto-fit minmax, runs table scrolls in its container, zero document overflow.

openQuestions.title: Validate the stall threshold on real audio hardware
openQuestions.detail: In this sandbox Chromium renders to a null/virtual sink, so the 50 ms stall threshold and the bounded-deficit baseline were only observed there. On real devices the steady-state deficit sits near one hardware buffer; confirm the 50/25 ms hysteresis neither over- nor under-counts on a machine with actual audio output, and at a genuinely honoured large quantum (Chrome 153).

openQuestions.title: Consider surfacing AudioContext.playoutStats when it ships
openQuestions.detail: The render-deficit metric is an honest proxy, but Chrome's proposed playout statistics API would give real underrun counts. When that surface is stable, a follow-up concept could compare proxy vs native counts.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Explicit labels on every control, native elements first, and non-visual equivalents (live regions, text meters) for changing visual state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All controls are labelled native elements; meters are a dl of text values; status changes announce via role=status aria-live=polite.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid with repeat(auto-fit, minmax()) for reflowing tile layouts; flex-wrap for control rows; avoid fixed widths that overflow narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Meters use auto-fit minmax(150px,1fr); control rows wrap; the slider field is flex:1 with a max-width; long code tokens wrap via overflow-wrap:anywhere.

guidanceConsulted.query: button triggers async API call show pending state disable and announce result to screen readers
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Reflect async action state on the triggering controls and announce outcomes in a live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Start disables itself while running, stop/jank enable only when a context is live, and every transition writes to the polite status region.

summary: Measured latency/throughput trade-off lab: a stress worklet tracks the render deficit (wall-clock vs rendered audio) with stall-episode counting, honest about Date.now() resolution and bursty pull scheduling. CDP-verified on sandbox Chromium 141: bounded deficit at idle, growing deficit and a stall under 3000 sin()/sample load, and main-thread jank correctly leaving the render thread untouched.
